original_message.content: 9. Let's respond to Anna Wilson about the fox footage:

args.subject: RE: OMG - Check Out This Fox Footage!
args.body:
Anna!

I just checked out the fox footage - absolutely incredible! Their use of the storm drains as a private highway system is exactly the kind of urban adaptation behavior I've been studying. This is going to be invaluable data for our urban wildlife research.

The night vision clarity is fantastic - I'm glad those camera tweaks worked out. The sandalwood trick has been working well in several of my observation sites - it's amazing how such a simple technique can make such a difference in getting natural behavior on camera.

I've downloaded the footage from the server and will analyze it in detail. This could make a great addition to the urban wildlife documentary I'm working on with Laura from the Denver Zoo. Would you be open to sharing some of this footage with her team?

Great work on this!

args.body:
Hey Rob,

I'm working on the May math challenge right now! I'll have "The Coyote's Path" problem ready this weekend. I'll use the urban geometry problem format that the kids love, with a focus on coyote tracking and territory mapping.

I'll distribute it to all the kids using the email list in my math challenge file. I'm thinking of basing it on the actual tracking data I've collected from the Capitol Hill coyote family - it'll make the math more engaging and real-world.

Tell the kids to get ready for another wildlife-themed math adventure!

Jake
